result.title: Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs
result.summary: Can an AI make a trained language model more mature, in the sense of a better organized latent space, by looking only at the geometry of that space? An analyst model reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors of the layers of a frozen target and proposes a transformation, which closed-form ridge regression writes into the feed-forward weights without gradient training. Using lightweight models, 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits. In a five-model round robin approach, 16 pairs raised purity and four left the target unchanged. The results provide a baseline for future work on LLM-guided, training-free model editing without using raw weights.

AI.brief_summary: 论文探索能否仅依据冻结语言模型各层隐空间的几何摘要，由分析模型提出变换，再用闭式岭回归写入前馈权重，实现免梯度模型编辑；在轻量模型上以126次实验考察类别纯度与基准准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 「从表示几何诊断到免训练权重编辑」可供核查用于 VLM 隐状态中任务必要信息重整或受控几何扰动的可能，从而检验 latent 内容的因果作用；但原文不涉及视觉输入与推理状态生成。
